This release of the Red Hat build of OpenJDK 11 (11.0.32) with Extended Lifecycle Support for portable Linux serves as a replacement for the Red Hat build of OpenJDK 11 (11.0.31) and includes security and bug fixes as well as enhancements. For further information, refer to the release notes linked to in the References section.

Security Fix(es):

* JDK: Enhance TLS certificate handling (CVE-2026-46968)

* JDK: Improve DTLS handshaking (CVE-2026-46917)

* JDK: Enhance JPEG handling (CVE-2026-47010)

* JDK: Enhance XBM image support (CVE-2026-47021)

* JDK: Enhance Jar file processing (CVE-2026-47027)

* JDK: Improve certification checking (CVE-2026-60147)

* JDK: Enhance AWT ImagingLib (CVE-2026-47059)

* JDK: Enhance Jar handling (CVE-2026-47063)

* JDK: Improve Nashorn index handling (CVE-2026-47057)

* JDK: Enhance Dataview Implementation (CVE-2026-47058)

* JDK: Update LCMS to 2.19 (CVE-2026-41254)
